description: This file implements the HandleBusMessage class, which processes GStreamer bus messages such as state changes, end-of-stream, QoS, and errors, and notifies a client accordingly within a media playback context.

classes.name: HandleBusMessage
classes.description: A class responsible for handling GStreamer bus messages and translating them into client notifications within a media playback context.

methods.name: HandleBusMessage
methods.description: Constructor initializing the HandleBusMessage object with context, player, client, wrappers, and message.

methods.name: ~HandleBusMessage
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of message handling.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method that processes the GStreamer message based on its type and triggers appropriate client notifications.

methods.name: allSourcesEos
methods.description: Checks if all stream sources have reached end-of-stream.
